description: Dear Friends, On Monday night at the close of our last legislative session for this year, I made a statement in solidarity with LGBTQ North Carolinians in response to Lt. Governor Mark Robinson’s recent, hateful statements about that community. He presides over the Senate, and I could not remain silent under his gavel any longer. […]
paid_for_by: Paid for by Julie Mayfield for NC Senate
title: I will not be bullied. I stand in solidarity with LGBTQ North Carolinians - Julie Mayfield for NC Senate
